about: Corrections applied to GeoNames data during the build (D-088). Each entry gives the GeoNames id, the field, the value GeoNames has (the build stops if it no longer matches, so a data refresh is checked by hand) and the corrected value, with the source.

corrections.name: Kandivli
corrections.reason: GeoNames codes Kandivli as Mumbai Suburban (IN.16.518) but places it near Satara, about 135 km south of Mumbai.
corrections.source: Wikipedia, Kandivali (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kandivali): 19°12′16″N 72°50′16″E = 19.204511, 72.837639; same point in Wikidata Q6361552 (https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q6361552). GeoNames' own Kandivli railway station (11858534) is at 19.20455, 72.8521, about 1.5 km away.
